messages:
lucy: Quick one for month-end  we invoiced Customer X for an annual commit (USD 360k) on 2026-06-03. Contract includes a $60k onboarding services fee (one-time) and $300k subscription (12 months). Finance needs the revenue schedule for June close.

maya: Thanks Lucy. Do we have the contract PDF and the revenue allocation breakdown from Sales?

lucy: Uploaded contract to the deal record and attached to the ticket: /files/contract_CUSTX_2026-06-01.pdf. Sales split was 60k services, 300k SaaS.

jorge: For accounting: onboarding services are recognized over the delivery period (Sales says delivery spans June-August). Do we treat services as over time (3 months) or upfront?

ashley: If services are distinct and delivered over 3 months, recognize pro rata over Jun/Jul/Aug (DR Deferred Revenue, CR Services Revenue each month). Subscription should be ratably recognized over 12 months starting June.

paul: Suggest we create two revenue schedules: (1) Services deferral: $60,000 over 3 months = $20,000/mo; (2) Subscription deferral: $300,000 over 12 months = $25,000/mo. Initial JE to move cash to deferred revenue on invoice date.

lucy: Draft JE for invoice (2026-06-03):

```
DR 1020-Cash/AR               $360,000
CR 2310-Deferred Revenue      $360,000
Memo: Billing for annual commit - Customer X; split to be scheduled between services/subscription.
```

maya: Then monthly recognition starting June should be: 6/30 recognize $20k services + $25k subscription = $45k.

ashley: Right. Monthly revenue JE (example for 6/30):

```
DR 2310-Deferred Revenue      $45,000
CR 4000-Services Revenue      $20,000
CR 4010-Subscription Revenue  $25,000
Memo: Revenue recognition for Customer X - Jun 2026 portion of onboarding and subscription.
```

jorge: Two bookkeeping notes: 1) Ensure GL mapping matches our revenue subaccounts (services vs subscription). 2) Contract states some portion of services may be refundable if not completed; we might want to maintain a separate liability for refundable onboarding credits.

paul: Good call. Sales confirmed no refund clause for the initial onboarding in this contract. No separate refundable liability needed.

acct-bot: Deal and invoice exports attached: invoice_1956000000_CUSTX.pdf, contract_CUSTX_2026-06-01.pdf (automated).

lucy: Requesting RevOps/Revenue Owner sign-off before we create the schedules in the RevRec system. @ashley can you sign off?

ashley: Approved. Please include a short narrative in the RevRec entry noting 3-month service delivery window and start date June 3. Also tag this as a new customer large commit (for disclosure).

maya: Tax check: any sales tax on the services portion? @paul - do we need to adjust tax base or accrue tax differently across months?

paul: Services are taxable in the customer's jurisdiction; tax was collected on the invoice. Since we're recognizing revenue over time but tax was remitted on billing, we need to ensure tax reporting aligns with invoicing. No additional tax JE needed at recognition; ensure tax memo references invoice date.

jorge: One more item: ARR/MRR implications. Should we record ARR uplift at invoice or upon recognition? Our policy records contracted ARR on signing for ACV metrics, but MRR should reflect recognized subscription revenue (i.e., $25k/mo).

lucy: Correct - Sales/RevOps track ACV; Finance will reflect MRR as recognized subscription revenue. Add note to the close pack.

maya: I'll create the revenue schedules and the initial deferral JE today and route through GL owner for posting. Plan: create schedules by 3pm PT, post JE before 5pm PT.

ashley: Attachments required for audit: contract PDF, invoice PDF, sales approval email. Please include these when routing.

lucy: All materials attached to the month-end ticket. Tagging thread with month-end checklist.

paul: LGTM. Once posted, please update the RevRec dashboard so month view shows the $45k for June.

maya: Will update when JE posted. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
